FISHING LICENCE · BOLIVIA

Bolivia fishing licence

Permit requirements depend on the department and protected area. Santa Cruz requires sport anglers to register and obtain a licence or permit; confirm the rule for your exact destination.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Sport anglers in Santa Cruz Department must register and obtain authorization.

Rules visitors should know

  • Do not sell a recreational catch under Santa Cruz's sport fishing category.
  • Follow the basin-specific species, size and gear rules.

How to buy

Contact the relevant departmental fisheries authority. In Santa Cruz, request the sport fishing registration and permit procedure.
